description: Official NASA Human Research Program risks referenced by the FUTURE modules (Space Health Profile domains, symptom assessment, EVA). Titles are copied verbatim from the Human Research Roadmap risk index and checked by scripts/check-hrr-references.mjs. The association between a risk and an ASTRA Health domain, symptom or EVA step was chosen by Team ANGARIS; it is not a NASA statement. Entries marked 'reference-only' have only their official title and link in the local library: ASTRA Health has not reviewed their content and shows no excerpt from them.
source: NASA Human Research Program — Human Research Roadmap (HRR), risk index
